KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Maamkuzi na Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maamkuzi na Maagano.
